Leo Tolstoy, The Kingdom of God Is Within You, translated by Leo Wiener.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/leo-tolstoy/the-kingdom-of-god-is-within-you/leo-wiener

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Leo Tolstoy, the author, died 1910 (Wikidata Q7243, P570 = 1910-11-07, 1910-11-10 and 1910-11-20).
- Leo Wiener, the translator, died 1939 (Wikidata Q4111504, P570 = 1939-01-01).

First publication of the text used: 1905 for the English translation (the Russian original was written in 1893). SE colophon: 'The Kingdom of God Is Within You was written in 1893 by Count Lev Nikolayevich Tolstoy. It was translated from Russian in 1905 by Leo Wiener.'

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1905, before 1931, and the edition's rights statement (quoted below) places it in the United States public domain.
- Country of origin of the English text (not stated in the facts; the possible countries are the United Kingdom, Ireland, the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India and South Africa): each has a copyright term of life plus 70 years or less. The last person to die (Wiener, 1939) makes the translation public domain in each of them no later than 1 January 2010. Country of origin of the Russian original (written in 1893; its first publication country is not stated in the facts; the author's country is Russia): for Tolstoy, who died in 1910, a term of life plus 70 years ends on 31 December 1980, so the original is in the public domain from 1 January 1981 in Russia and in every other country with a term of life plus 70 years or less. No person named above worked or fought in World War II, so the Russian wartime extension does not apply.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."

Sources of these facts:

- Wikidata Q7243 (Leo Tolstoy), P570 = 1910-11-07, 1910-11-10 and 1910-11-20.
